verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Supabase AI Assistant is built into the Dashboard. It generates SQL queries from your specifications, analyzes SQL errors and suggests fixes, and gives context-aware recommendations for the table you are working on. That covers writing queries and debugging errors directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the assistant explaining the overall backend (only table-level feedback is described), debugging beyond SQL errors (e.g., logs or function errors), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
